releases.name: v1.4.0 — accurate AVG, idle-stop scheduler, per-cell particles
releases.body:
Rolls up the v1.3.x line into one stable release. No code changes since v1.3.2.

## Measurement
- **AVG / live TPS are no longer inflated by tool calls.** Streaming of tool-call arguments now counts toward live TPS and the AVG generation window. Steps that made tool calls without streamed arguments are left out of AVG and calibration.
- Reasoning tokens are only counted when the reasoning was actually streamed.
- The spinner stops after an interrupt or error.
- A completion only clears the live state of the message that is currently streaming.

## Performance and display
- No timers and no re-renders while idle. Updates are throttled and only re-render when the text changes.
- The meter is a single text node: the idle line is exactly `TPS -- | AVG -- | TTFT --`, and the thinking stream has a per-cell color gradient again.
- Writing to a destroyed view can no longer throw.

## opencode 2.x
- The meter follows session switches, and the slot is unregistered on dispose.

## Options
- `spinner.intervalMs` is clamped to 40–1000 and `spinner.cells` to 2–16. Invalid colors and invalid tiers fall back to the defaults.

## Engineering
- 67 unit tests, plus a sync test for the measurement region shared by `measure.ts` and `tui.tsx`.
- CI and Publish run `tsc` and `npm run smoke-install`.
- `npm audit` reports 0 for the repo.
- Added a LICENSE file (MIT).

## Notes
- The peer dependencies stay **required**. v1.3.1 tried making them optional to slim the install, and the meter stopped loading on opencode 1.x (fixed in v1.3.2). The install is therefore still about 126 MB, and the Dependabot runtime alerts come from opencode's own packages.

## Updating
Run `npm cache clean --force`, delete `~/.cache/opencode/packages/@jack-yang/opencode-tps-meter@latest`, then run `opencode plugin @jack-yang/opencode-tps-meter -g -f` and restart opencode.

releases.name: v1.3.2 — fix: meter missing on opencode 1.x (revert optional peers)
releases.body:
## Fix: the meter did not appear with v1.3.1

v1.3.1 made the `@opentui/*`, `solid-js` and `@opencode-ai/plugin` peer dependencies optional to slim the install. On opencode 1.x (tested on 1.19.5), the plugin then failed to load and the meter disappeared. This release reverts that change: the peers are installed again.

Everything else from v1.3.1 stays: the dev tree's security overrides and vitest 4 upgrade (`npm audit`: 0), and the `npm run smoke-install` check in CI/Publish, which now asserts the required peers are installed.

No change to the plugin code (`tui.tsx`).

## Updating
Run `npm cache clean --force`, delete `~/.cache/opencode/packages/@jack-yang/opencode-tps-meter@latest`, then run `opencode plugin @jack-yang/opencode-tps-meter -g -f` and restart opencode.

releases.name: v1.3.1 — optional peers: ~46 KB install, no vulnerable deps
releases.body: **Superseded by v1.3.2.** This release made the peer dependencies optional, which broke loading on opencode 1.x (the meter did not appear). Use v1.3.2.

releases.name: v1.3.0 — accurate AVG, idle-stop, per-cell particle colors
releases.body:
## Fixes
- **AVG / live TPS no longer inflated by tool calls.** Tool-call argument streaming now counts toward live TPS and the AVG generation window. Steps that made tool calls without streamed arguments (older opencode) are excluded from AVG/calibration instead of being counted as "N tokens in 1s".
- **Non-streamed reasoning is not counted** (models that report reasoning tokens without streaming them).
- **Spinner no longer gets stuck** after an interrupt or error (`session.idle` / `session.error`, V2 `session.execution.*`, plus a stale fallback).
- A completion only clears the live state of the message that is actually streaming.
- Writing to a destroyed renderable can no longer throw; one failing view doesn't break the others.
- opencode 2.x: the meter follows session switches, and the slot is unregistered on dispose.

## Performance
- No timers and no re-renders while idle. Updates are throttled (≤10 Hz, or the spinner interval while thinking) and only re-render when the text actually changes.

## Display
- Single text node: the idle line is exactly `TPS -- | AVG -- | TTFT --` with no trailing gap. Per-cell gradient in the thinking stream is back.

## Options
- `spinner.intervalMs` is clamped to 40–1000 and `spinner.cells` to 2–16. Invalid hex colors and non-ascending tiers fall back to the defaults.

## Engineering
- Pure measurement logic is shared between `measure.ts` and `tui.tsx`, with a sync test enforcing it (67 tests). CI now runs `tsc`. The manual Publish trigger was removed. Added a LICENSE file (MIT).

## Updating
opencode 1.x: delete `~/.cache/opencode/packages/@jack-yang/opencode-tps-meter@latest`, run `opencode plugin @jack-yang/opencode-tps-meter -g -f`, then restart opencode.

releases.name: v1.2.0 — OpenCode 2.x support (one package, both versions)
releases.body:
## Added

- **OpenCode 2.x support** — one package now loads on both opencode 1.x and 2.x. The default export carries two entrypoints: `tui` (V1) and `setup` (V2, new plugin API). The measurement core (TPS / AVG / TTFT / thinking stream) is shared and unchanged.

## How it works on 2.x

- Events: `session.text.delta` / `session.reasoning.delta` (streaming TPS), `session.step.started` (TTFT origin), `session.step.ended` (AVG + calibration), `session.step.failed` / `session.tool.input.started` (clear live state).
- Render: `ctx.ui.slot({ append: "prompt.footer.status" })` — V1's `session_prompt_right` slot no longer exists in V2. Override with the new `slot` option if placement needs adjusting.
- Theme: V2 semantic tokens (`text.muted`, `text.feedback.*.base`, `hue.accent[500]`).
- No new dependencies: V2 API types are declared locally; nothing is imported from `@opencode/plugin` at runtime.

## Install

```bash
# opencode 1.x (unchanged)
opencode plugin @jack-yang/opencode-tps-meter -g

# opencode 2.x
opencode plugin add @jack-yang/opencode-tps-meter
```

On 2.x, terminal-client plugin config lives in `~/.config/opencode/cli.json` under `plugins` (your `tui.json` is migrated automatically). Options are the same as before; 2.x uses the object form:

```json
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "@jack-yang/opencode-tps-meter",
      "options": { "spinner": { "theme": "tech", "cells": 6 } }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Feedback wanted (2.x)

The V2 adapter is verified against the published 2.x type definitions but not yet against a running V2 binary. If the meter shows in an unexpected spot, set the `slot` option (e.g. `"prompt.footer"`, `"session.composer.top"`) and please open an issue with a screenshot.

opencode 1.x behavior is unchanged (tested on 1.17.20 / 1.18.30).
